title: 59. The Pen Scribbles
paragraphs: My pen, it scribbles: this is hell! Have I been damned to have to scribble? – I dip it boldly in the well and write broad streams of inky drivel. See how it flows, so full, so pure! See how each thing I try succeeds! The text’s not lucid, to be sure – So what? What I write no one reads.
